description: Turn a request into an approvable contract: three independent analysts, a judge that merges and never re-asks, then a cold God Eye critique once nothing is open.

fanout.brief: Where could two competent engineers read this contract differently?
What limits (compatibility, performance, security, data, style) does the repo impose that the contract doesn't state?
Can every acceptance criterion be proven by its stated evidence type? What would the test actually check?
